program: F124-D independent scientific experiment, not FORGE autonomy F124 #435 or F125 #436
negative_reason: F124-C learned A/B 0/48 paired in BOTH lanes. All three-hop pairs classified both-positive and four-hop pairs both-negative. Optimistic post-hoc TRAIN threshold rescued 10/48 or 9/48 only. B almost identical to A with no distinct causal slot binding. Fixed 12/16 raw comparator attained 41/48 and 37/48. Do not retune, reclassify, or open its confirmation.
hypothesis: Actually trained, mass-conserving competitive assignment to two differentiated persistent per-node variable slots with hop-normalized gates and paired contrastive objective can preserve causally valid information under new two-stage path reconvergences, outperforming nonlearned route approximations under comparable compute/state budgets.

arms.A: Two persistent per-node latent slots, learned 16-bit to 8-value embedding, slot-dependent compatibility, learned softmax competitive assignment and explicitly bounded per-hop conservation/normalization. No route enumeration or truth-marker feature. Bidirectional gradients from labels, source only TRAIN.
arms.B: Arm A + learned residual slot gate and differentiable slot-diversity regularizer. Exactly two slots, same public graph information, fixed budget; no hardcoded true path, equality bit or future query leak.

training.update: Deterministic cyclic balanced TRAIN minibatches, 4 pairs/epoch; 0.5 mean binary BCE plus 0.5 pair-ranking softplus objective; B additionally 0.03 slot-overlap penalty; clip finite SGD gradients and do not change epoch/step after seeing outcomes.
training.decision_rule: 0.5 sigmoid probability for both positive and negative; no heldout-calibration. Paired accuracy primary; TRAIN-only Arm A/B selector by paired correctness with A winning ties.

environment.input: Raw unordered graph nodes, roles, start/target and 16-bit edge src/dst tokens only; strict public schema with no oracle true path, changed-edge marker, precomputed equality bit or source vector id.
environment.new_families: Novel salted source cohort with 4-5 hop TRAIN and reserved 7-9 hop CONFIRM; two-stage internal many-to-one reconvergences with >=3 route-compatible branches, parallel edges and near-collision aliases. Exactly one positive valid public path and zero negative public valid paths.
environment.counterfactual: Swap the src token on a necessary continuation with an off-route role-mismatched edge src token; preserve public query, full directed multigraph topology, degrees, role counts, raw token multiset, and edge count; pair balancing.
environment.prohibit_shortcuts: Public role-only, topology-only, depth-only, raw token histogram-only and edge order effects must be tested. Quarantine ambiguous truth and any label-informative structural artifacts.

controls.fixed_hamming_12of16: Public source-compatible 12-of-16 approximate Hamming graph traversal; never treated as exact solver; count actual bit tests.
controls.role_only: Graph role reachability without raw token identity.
controls.topology_only: Public query + degree/role 20-feature learner trained 100 epochs without raw tokens.
controls.histogram_only: Global raw-token histogram ignoring topology association.
controls.exact_public_symbolic: Report full exact public path consistency separately as computational ceiling, never eligible nonlearned threshold comparator.
controls.frozen_f124c: Preserve original negative model and resource evidence without retroactive model tuning; any adapter for cross-source comparison is separately disclosed, not first-use.

evaluation.primary: New 7-9 hop CONFIRM paired accuracy and binary balanced accuracy in BOTH Wingless/Yggdrasil lanes, against strongest eligible equal-information, resource-matched heuristic; symbolic ceiling separately.
evaluation.development_success: At least +0.05 paired accuracy vs strongest eligible matched-resource nonlearned control in BOTH lanes, no alias/rejoin/collision stratum degradation, nonzero learned updates, no source leakage, causally aligned interventions; otherwise negative/inconclusive.
evaluation.causal_ablation: Posthoc leave-one-join-edge out and leave-one-slot-out tests, source-token swaps, edge permutations, cross-route splicing audit using independent exact public oracle only in scorer.
evaluation.compute: Count for every arm/control public edge scans, raw-bit comparisons, multiply-adds, exp/sigmoid, peak state slots/live messages, parameter count, serial memory, and report incomparable budgets rather than equal-cost claim.
evaluation.custody: Bind freeze Git blob, exact source/model SHA, original TRAIN vectors and candidate SHA, negative record, frozen control code, weights/receipt digest, exact-head CI and independent first-use authority; never silent acceptance.
